spans.s:
गृभ् गृभ्, प्, f. (fr. ग्रह्), Ved. grasping,
seizing, grasp, hold.

गृभ, अस्, m., Ved. the place where anything is
seized, handle, hold.
गृभि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. holding, containing, bearing.

गृभीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. grasped, seized; im-
pregnated, bearing fruit.
—गृभीत-ताति, इस्, f., Ved.
the being seized or grasped.
